attempts.summary: Set up a LUKS2-encrypted, file-backed volume (/var/lib/secure-vol/secure.img) on node1, mounted at /srv/secure via a keyfile-based /etc/crypttab entry and matching /etc/fstab entry. Verified the volume auto-unlocks and auto-mounts unattended across a real reboot (boot_id changed, no manual cryptsetup/mount commands issued post-reboot), with test data intact.
